{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Define the QA order threshold
QA_REVENUE = 999999.99

# Identify QA orders (exactly 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == QA_REVENUE

# Check: how many QA orders are in 'completed'?
qa_in_completed = qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')
print(f"Number of QA orders in 'completed' status: {qa_in_completed.sum()}")

# Filter the data: only completed orders AND exclude QA orders
completed_clean_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (~qa_mask)]

# Verify that no QA orders remain in the completed set
assert completed_clean_df['revenue_clean'].eq(QA_REVENUE).sum() == 0, "QA orders still present in completed set after filtering"

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = completed_clean_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the final result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f} USD")"}
